info.title: tamper-evident: verify EfCore.TamperEvident evidence bundles
info.description: A .NET tool for auditors: verifies EfCore.TamperEvident evidence bundles offline (every hash, link, redaction, signed chain head and anchor), summarizes them, and generates strong secret keys.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Summarize a bundle without verifying it

commands.name: keygen
commands.description: Print a new random secret key (base64)

options.name: --key-env
options.description: Read the secret from an environment variable (default: TAMPER_EVIDENT_KEY)

options.name: --key-file
options.description: Read the secret from a file

options.name: --key-stdin
options.description: Read the secret from the first line of standard input

options.name: --key-id
options.description: The key id of the secret (when key rotation is used)

options.name: --retired-key
options.description: A retired key that older entries were sealed with (repeatable; also file:<PATH>)

options.name: --anchors
options.description:
Anchors received outside of the database (repeatable): a file written by
FileAnchorPublisher, or any text such as saved anchor e-mails

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the result as JSON
